entities.summary: Ado Bayero was a political leaders in Kano State (1930-07-25, Kano State – 2014-06-06), a notable figure of the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
